## Pull request overview

Updates the docs homepage version badge to automatically reflect the current `@objectstack/spec` version (instead of hardcoded strings), keeping the English and Chinese homepages in sync with the spec package.

**Changes:**
- Added a `SPEC_VERSION` constant that derives `v{version}` from the spec package’s `package.json`.
- Updated homepage i18n translations (EN/CN) to use `SPEC_VERSION` for the badge version display.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 2 out of 2 changed files in this pull request and generated 1 comment.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| apps/docs/lib/version.ts | Introduces `SPEC_VERSION` sourced from the spec package metadata. |
| apps/docs/lib/homepage-i18n.ts | Replaces hardcoded badge version strings with `SPEC_VERSION` for EN/CN. |

Importing `packages/spec/package.json` via a deep relative path hard-codes the monorepo layout and reaches across package boundaries. Consider switching to reading the installed workspace package (e.g., add `@objectstack/spec` as a dependency and resolve its package root at runtime/build-time) or exposing a version export from `@objectstack/spec`, so `apps/docs` doesn’t depend on `../../../packages/...` paths.
